blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video generation must account for two sources of motion, one induced by the observer’s camera path and the other caused by scene dynamics. An ideal camera-controlled video model should account for both motions: let users move the camera while evolving the scene dynamics. While current models handle camera-induced motion well in static settings, they struggle for dynamic scenes: objects are static, move incorrectly, or degrade in generation quality. We introduce DynaTokens, a lightweight set of learnable scene-specific tokens that teach dynamics to an existing camera-controlled world model. Our method is motivated by a simple asymmetry between the two sources of motion: whereas camera motion affects the generated view globally, object dynamics are spatially localized. Through cross-attention, DynaTokens trains the learnable tokens from a few example trajectories for a scene while keeping the base model frozen, and enables dynamics under new query camera paths. DynaTokens achieves a better simultaneous dynamics-camera tradeoff on VBench2 and WorldScore evaluations than LoRA, block finetuning, and specialized trainable-layer baselines. Analyses of token attention, ablations, and motion temporality suggest that matching the trainable interface to the structure of the learning target is important for effective adaptation. Project website: https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/
blocks.zh: 视频生成必须说明两个运动源,一个是由观察者的相机路径诱导的,另一个是由场景动态引发的. 一个理想的相机控制的视频模型应该兼顾这两个动作:让用户在演化场景动态的同时移动相机. 虽然目前的模型在静态环境下处理相机引起的运动井,但它们为动态场景而挣扎:物体是静态的,移动不正确,或者在生成质量上降解. 我们介绍DynaTokens, 一套轻量级的可学习的场景特异性标志, 教给现有的相机控制的世界模型。 我们的方法的动机是两个运动源之间的简单不对称:相机运动影响全球生成的视野,而物体动力学则在空间上局部化。 通过交叉注意,DynaTokens从几个实例的轨迹中为一个场景训练可学习的符号,同时保持基模型的冻结,并在新的查询相机路径下实现动态. DynaTokens在V Bench2和WorldScore评价上实现了比LORA更好的同时动态-相机比对,区块微调,专业化的可训练级基线. 对象征性的注意度、时间性和运动性的分析表明,使可训练界面与学习目标的结构相匹配对于有效的适应十分重要。 项目网站:https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Current camera-controlled video models [ 23 , 25 , 2 , 22 , 30 , 10 ] can generate navigable “worlds” from a image or text prompts, opening new possibilities for gaming, immersive media, and robotics.
However, despite their ability to follow camera trajectories, these models struggle with dynamics [ 31 , 18 ] : the generated worlds often looks static, generate incorrect motion, or degrade in visual quality when the scene should evolve.
blocks.zh:
目前相机控制的视频模型[23, 25, 2, 22, 30, 10]能够从图像或文本提示生成可导航的“世界”,为游戏,浸泡媒体,机器人开辟了新的可能性.
然而,尽管这些模型能够跟随相机轨迹,却与动力学[31,18]挣扎:生成的世界往往看起来静止,产生不正确的运动,或者当场景应该演化时在视觉质量上退化.

blocks.en: Recent work has shown that test-time training can adapt video foundation models to support new capabilities, including long-horizon generation [ 7 ] , scientific discovery [ 32 ] , and reasoning [ 1 ] . However, enabling scene dynamics in camera-controlled video models remains challenging because current architectures inject camera information directly into the generative flow process – via PRoPE [ 15 ] , Plücker ray embeddings [ 33 ] , or action conditioning [ 23 , 10 ] – entangling camera control with dynamics generation. As a result, supervision on dynamics can inadvertently degrade camera control, and naive fine-tuning methods such as LoRA [ 11 ] perform poorly. This observation motivates a new approach to model adaptation. We introduce DynaTokens, a test-time training method that selectively teaches scene dynamics while preserving the camera-control behavior.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作表明,测试时间培训可以调整视频基础模型以支持新的能力,包括长视生成[7],科学发现[32],推理[1]. 然而,摄像头控制的视频模型中的能动场景动态仍然具有挑战性,因为目前的架构将相机信息直接注入基因流过程——通过PROPE[15],普吕克射线嵌入[33],或动作调制[23,10]——将相机控制与动态生成相结合. 因此,对动态的监管可能会无意中降低相机控制,天真的微调方法如LORA[11]等表现不佳. 这一观察激励了一种新的适应模式。 我们引入了DynaTokens,一种测试时间的训练方法,它有选择地教授场景动力学,同时保留摄像机控制行为.

blocks.en:
DynaTokens builds on a simple principle: in video generation, camera control is global, influencing every patch across every frame, whereas scene dynamics can be spatially local, often confined to the objects that move or change.
To exploit this distinction, DynaTokens introduces learnable tokens that steer the video latents toward localized dynamics without altering the global scene generation.
By decoupling local dynamic control from global camera control, this design enables dynamic scene generation while preserving camera controllability.
blocks.zh:
DynaTokens基于一个简单的原则:在视频生成中,相机控制是全球性的,会影响每个帧的每一个补丁,而场景动态可以是空间局部的,往往局限于移动或改变的物体.
为了利用这种区别,DynaTokens引入了可学习的符号,引导视频潜伏到局部动态,而不改变全球场景的生成。
通过将局部动态控制与全球相机控制脱钩,这种设计既能实现动态场景生成,又能保持相机可控性.

blocks.en: DynaTokens is lightweight: a few scene-specific tokens are added and learned while keeping the base model frozen. It can be trained from only a few samples ( ≈ 15 \approx 15 ) and generalize to unseen camera trajectories, producing videos under novel camera controls. Importantly, these few training trajectories need not be high quality: they can be short, contain background artifacts or motion discontinuity. Through test-time training of the tokens, DynaTokens can overcome these limitations, generating temporally continuous videos with prompt-aligned dynamics for new trajectories.
blocks.zh: DynaTokens为轻量级:在保持基模冷冻的同时,还添加并学习了几个场景特有标志. 它只能从几个样本(QQ 15 \ 大约 15 )中接受训练,并概括到看不见的相机轨迹,在新的相机控制下制作视频. 重要的是,这些为数不多的训练轨迹不一定是高质量的:它们可能很短,包含背景文物或运动不连续. 通过符号的测试时间训练,DynaTokens可以克服这些限制,生成时间上连续的视频,为新的轨迹迅速配音.

blocks.en: We show quantitatively and qualitatively that DynaTokens effectively enables dynamics without compromising camera control, surpassing current capabilities of state-of-the-art camera-controlled world models on VBench2 [ 35 ] dynamic-related categories and WorldScore [ 8 ] . Baseline methods such as LoRA, block finetuning, or Test-Time Training layers struggle. Beyond dynamic motion categories, we show that DynaTokens can also enable physics and stylistic changes.
blocks.zh: 我们从数量和质量上表明,DynaTokens在不损害相机控制的情况下有效实现动态,超过了V Bench2[35]动态相关类别和WorldScore[8]上最先进的相机控制世界模型的现有能力。 基线方法如LORA,区块微调,或测试-时间训练层挣扎. 除了动态运动分类之外,我们显示DynaTokens还可以使物理和结构变化成为可能.

blocks.en:
We provide analysis on the DynaTokens design to understand the disentangling of dynamics with camera control. We also probe the temporality aspects of dynamic tokens to better understand how they elicit dynamic behavior of base models. Our analyses on test-time training of dynamic tokens provide deeper insight into architecture and representation of world models, paving the way for future development of large-scale world models. We also illuminate how to effectively adapt these models at test time to enable new capabilities.
Additionally, DynaTokens offers a path toward video data generation. Existing efforts in collecting dynamic, camera-annotated data rely on synthetic environments, such as games [ 6 ] . DynaTokens, via efficient test-time training, opens up generation of camera-controlled videos in diverse settings.
blocks.zh:
我们对DynaTokens的设计进行分析 以了解动态与相机控制的脱节 我们还探究了动态符号的时间性方面,以更好地了解它们是如何引起基础模型的动态行为的. 我们对动态标志的试验时间培训的分析使人们更深入地了解世界模型的结构和代表性,为今后大规模世界模型的发展铺平道路。 我们还阐明如何在试验时有效地调整这些模型,以促成新的能力。
此外,DynaTokens还提供了一条视频数据生成的道路。 目前收集动态,相机附加说明的数据的努力依赖于合成环境,如游戏[6]. DynaTokens通过高效的测试时间培训,在各种场合开启了摄像头控制的视频的生成.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • We develop DynaTokens, which significantly improves dynamic scene generation for camera-controlled video models via test-time training, evaluated on VBench2 and WorldScore. • DynaTokens is a new architecture design which decouples dynamics from camera control, enables much better performance than alternatives like LoRA and TTT layers. • We identify a structural mismatch between existing adaptation methods and the underlying transformations they model: LoRA-type methods apply global parameter updates, whereas object dynamics is spatially localized. We provide analysis on how DynaTokens overcomes this limitation via a design that aligns with the learning target.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们开发了DynaTokens,通过测试时间训练,在V Bench2和WorldScore上大大改进了相机控制视频模型的动态场景生成. • 支助 DynaTokens是一种新的建筑设计,它将动态与相机控制脱钩,能够比Lora和TTT层等替代品更好的性能. ^ 我们发现现有适应方法与它们模拟的基本转变之间的结构不匹配:LORA型方法采用全球参数更新,而物体动力学是空间局部化的。 我们分析DynaTokens如何通过符合学习目标的设计来克服这种限制。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Camera-controlled video models are flow-based video generation models that take in camera control, along with image and text, as conditioning signals. Camera conditioning can be achieved in 4 ways: noise warping [ 4 , 22 ] which warps the noise based on camera movement, PRoPE [ 23 , 31 ] which encodes camera frustum in positional embedding, action conditioning [ 23 , 10 ] which encodes discrete camera actions, and plücker ray embedding [ 25 , 22 ] , usually channel-wise concatenated. We design DynaTokens to minimally affect camera conditioning and selectively “teach” dynamics.
blocks.zh: 相机控制的视频模型是采用相机控制的流动视频生成模型,与图像和文本一起作为调节信号. 相机调制可以通过以下4种方式实现: 噪声振动 [4,22] 以相机运动来曲解噪声, PRoPE [23, 31] 以位置嵌入方式编码相机风扇, 动作调制 [23, 10] 编码离散相机动作, 和 Plücker 射线嵌入 [25, 22] , 通常通过信道调制. 我们设计DynaTokens, 以最小程度地影响相机的构造,

blocks.en: Camera-controlled video models [ 23 , 25 , 22 , 10 ] struggle with dynamics due to a combination of 3D prior [ 2 , 22 ] and the lack of dynamics in training data [ 17 ] . Methods that tackle dynamics can fall into two categories: (1) Improving existing general-purpose world models. These methods mostly focus on loosening 3D constraints in memory, such as [ 6 , 9 , 31 ] , which addresses out-of-frame dynamics. (2) Alternative formulations of 4D-aware generation models, such as BulletTime [ 29 ] which allows both camera and time control, but is limited to short and small-range camera movements. The recent Atlas model [ 26 ] enables camera-controlled dynamics generation, but requires multiple input views.
blocks.zh: 相机控制视频模型 [23, 25, 22, 10] 由于3D前的组合 [2, 22] 和培训数据缺乏动态 [17]. 处理动态的方法可分为两类: (1)完善现有通用世界模式. 这些方法主要侧重于放松记忆中的3D限制,例如[6,9,31],解决框架外动态. (2) 4D-意识生成模型的替代配体,例如BulletTime[29],既允许相机,也允许时间控制,但仅限于短程和小程相机运动. 最近的Atlas模型[26]可以实现相机控制的动态生成,但需要多个输入视图.

blocks.en: Test-time training methods train foundation models at test time to surpass base model capabilities in challenging tasks, such as the ARC challenge [ 1 ] , scientific discovery [ 32 ] , and long video generation [ 7 ] . Architecturally, test-time training methods either use LoRA [ 1 ] or specialized architectures like Test-time Training (TTT) layers [ 34 , 7 ] . We design DynaTokens, a new test-time training architecture for world models, to enable localized dynamic learning.
blocks.zh: 测试时间训练方法在测试时间训练基础模型,以超越在挑战任务中的基础模型能力,如ARC挑战[1],科学发现[32],以及长视频生成[7]. 在建筑方面,测试时间培训方法要么使用LORA[1],要么使用诸如测试时间培训(TTT)层等专业建筑[34,7]. 我们设计了DynaTokens, 一个新的测试时间训练架构, 用于世界模型, 以便本地化的动态学习。

blocks.en: DynaTokens introduces scene-specific tokens into a pretrained camera-controlled video generation model. During training, the base model is kept frozen, and only the tokens are updated, enabling correct dynamics when exploring different camera trajectories for the scene. We motivate the design of dynamic tokens, then explain our architecture, test-time training setup, and training objective.
blocks.zh: DynaTokens将特定场景的标志引入了预先训练的相机控制视频生成模型. 在训练期间,基型保持冷冻状态,仅更新符号,在为场景探索不同的相机轨迹时能够实现正确的动态. 我们激励设计动态符号,然后解释我们的架构,测试时间的训练设置以及训练目标.

blocks.en: 3.2 Our approach: dynamic tokens
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 我们的方法:动态符号

blocks.en:
To achieve this, we design a lightweight add-on architecture for pretrained camera-controlled video models, enabling test-time learning of scene dynamics while preserving camera control.
This presents two requirements: (1) the architecture needs to have enough representation capacity to “steer” the structure of the generated video latents while being lightweight; (2) the design should enable dynamics and camera control simultaneously.
blocks.zh:
为了实现这一目标,我们设计了一个轻量级的加载架构,用于预先训练的相机控制视频模型,在保持相机控制的同时,可以进行场景动态的试验时间学习.
这提出了两项要求:(1) 建筑结构需要有足够的代表能力,以便在轻量级的同时“加强”生成的视频潜伏体的结构;(2) 设计应能够同时进行动态和相机控制。

blocks.en:
We introduce DynaTokens, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (a).
Dynamic tokens are added to transformer blocks of a video generative model.
The input video patch tokens interact with the learned dynamic tokens via cross attention. The output is added back to the model, along with the two paths of self-attention, with and without camera control (often instantiated via PRoPE [ 15 ] ). We apply this to every double stream transformer block. The projection matrix that mixes multiple heads of cross-attention is initialized at zero to ensure minimal perturbation at initialization. We keep the base model frozen, and learn only the dynamic tokens at test time.
blocks.zh:
如图1(a)所示,我们介绍DynaTokens。
动态符号被添加到视频基因模型的变压器块中.
输入视频补丁符号通过交叉注意力与学到的动态符号相互作用. 输出被添加回模型中,连同自觉的两条路径,有和没有相机控制(往往通过PROPE[15]进行即时处理). 我们把这个应用到每一个双流变压器块。 混合多头交叉注意的投影矩阵以零为初始,以确保初始化时最小扰动. 我们把基座模型冷冻起来,在测试时只学习动态符号.

blocks.en: 3.3 Test-time training of dynamic tokens
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 动态符号的试验时间培训

blocks.en: Dynamic tokens are trained at test time to enable dynamic video generation. While large-scale data curation with rich scene and camera motion is difficult, DynaTokens’ lightweight design enables learning only from a few videos ( ≈ \approx 15), which are easier to curate. We design a curation process leveraging VLMs and video interpolation, detailed in § G of the Appendix, which yields videos with dynamics. These videos might contain artifacts, and we only curate them for a few camera trajectories. Trained on these few trajectories, DynaTokens enables correct dynamics on new camera trajectories. Our setup is illustrated in Fig. 1 (b).
blocks.zh: 动态符号在测试时接受训练,以允许动态视频生成. DynaTokens的轻量级设计只能从几部视频(QQ\\约15)中学习, 我们设计一个利用VLM和视频插图的图解过程,详见附录第G节,该图可产生动态视频。 这些视频可能包含文物,我们只为几部相机轨迹进行整理. DynaTokens对这些少数的轨迹进行了训练,在新的相机轨迹上实现了正确的动态. 图1(b)说明了我们的设置。

blocks.en: However, sample curation alone is insufficient: fine-tuning or LoRA-adapting a pretrained camera-controlled video model on the same data yields poor results, as we show in our experiments. In contrast, DynaTokens learns to generate the right dynamics under novel, unseen camera trajectories.
blocks.zh: 然而,单是样本校准是不够的:如我们在实验中所显示的那样,在相同数据上精细调整或LORA调整预先训练的相机控制视频模型,结果不佳。 相比之下,DynaTokens学会了在小说,看不见的相机轨迹下产生正确的动态.

blocks.en: We build on pretrained camera-controlled video models. As a representative architecture, we consider autoregressive video diffusion models, which generate videos chunk-by-chunk through diffusion. We instantiate our method on HY-WorldPlay [ 23 ] , a state-of-the-art camera-controlled video model.
blocks.zh: 我们利用预先训练的摄像机控制视频模型。 作为一个具有代表性的架构,我们考虑自动视频传播模式,通过传播生成逐块的视频。 我们用HY-WorldPlay[23],一种最先进的相机控制视频模型,来即时分析我们的方法.

blocks.en:
Training video models is challenging: even with discretized camera actions, a single scene can admit over 10 19 10^{19} possible trajectories over a 5-second clip. From only a handful of training trajectories ( ≈ \approx 15) we aim to teach the add-on dynamic tokens to capture scene motion and generalize to unseen camera paths.
To reduce exposure bias, where the model conditions on its own previous-chunk predictions that drift from the training setting, we leverage a diffusion-forcing-type [ 5 ] objective, similar to [ 23 , 22 ] : ℒ FM ( θ ) = 𝔼 l , t [ ‖ v θ ( x l ( t ) , x ~ 1 : l − 1 ( t ) , t ) − ( x l − x l ( 0 ) ) ‖ 2 ] \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}(\theta)=\mathbb{E}_{l,\,t}\left[\left\|v_{\theta}\!\big(x_{l}^{(t)},\,\tilde{x}_{1:l-1}^{(t)},\,t\big)-\big(x_{l}-x_{l}^{(0)}\big)\right\|^{2}\right] (2) where t t is the flow timestep and l l is the chunk index. We provide ablations on our design choices and hyperparameters in § 5 .

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We demonstrate the impact of DynaTokens: (1) whereas all current state-of-the-art camera-controlled video models struggle greatly with dynamics, DynaTokens can effectively enable dynamics within such models via test-time training; (2) alternative test-time training methods, such as LoRA [ 11 ] or TTT layer [ 7 ] , fail, while DynaTokens enables learning dynamics while maintaining camera control. We evaluate on a broad range of videos with dynamic changes, including motion ordering, dynamic spatial relations, text-based motion accuracy, physics, and style transformations.
blocks.zh: 我们演示了DynaTokens的影响: (1)虽然目前所有最先进的相机控制视频模型都与动态发生很大斗争,但DynaTokens可以通过测试时间培训,有效地使这些模型内部的动态发生; (2)其他的测试时间培训方法,如LORA [11]或TTT 层 [7],失败,而DynaTokens在保持相机控制的同时使学习动态发生. 包括运动顺序、动态空间关系、文字运动精度、物理和风格转变。

blocks.en:
Since there are no existing dynamics-focused benchmarks for camera-controlled world models, we repurpose existing video benchmarks for dynamics-related evaluation: VBench2 [ 35 ] and WorldScore [ 8 ] .
We evaluate two aspects: dynamics correctness and camera control correctness.
blocks.zh:
由于相机控制的世界模型没有现有的以动态为重点的基准,我们重新将现有的视频基准用于动态相关评价:V Bench2 [35]和WorldScore [8].
我们评价两个方面:动态正确性和摄像机控制正确性。

blocks.en: VBench2 is a text-to-video benchmark with VLM judges. While VBench2 holistically evaluates video models, we use its dynamics-related categories, “Dynamic Spatial Relations” (DSR, e.g., “a dog is on the left of the table, then the dog runs to the front of the table”) and “Motion Order Understanding” (MOU, e.g., “a person is cooking, then they suddenly start organizing the pantry”). The original evaluation assumes a static camera, thus we make slight modifications to accommodate camera movement, such as not evaluating on frames where the main object is out-of-view due to camera movement. For camera, we calcaulte an aggregate score over rotation and translation error like WorldScore [ 8 ] , leveraging state-of-the-art camera estimation method, ViPE [ 12 ] . We evaluate on a random subset of 20 prompts across the two categories, each for 6 different camera trajectories, on a total of 120 videos for VBench. Standard errors are reported in the Appendix.
blocks.zh: V Bench2是具有VLM评委的文本对视频基准. 虽然V Bench2对视频模型进行了整体评价,但我们使用了其动态相关类别,即“动态空间关系”(DSR,例如“一只狗在桌子左边,然后狗跑到桌子前面”)和“运动秩序理解”(MOU,例如“一个人在做饭,然后他们突然开始组织储藏室”。 最初的评价假设是静态相机,因此我们进行微小的修改以适应相机运动,比如在主体因相机运动而处于视线外的帧上没有评价. 对于相机,我们计算总分 超过旋转和翻译错误 如WorldScore [8], 杠杆 最新的相机估计方法, VIPE [12] 。 我们用20个提示的随机子集 来评估这两类, 6个不同的相机轨迹, 标准错误在附录中报告。

blocks.en: WorldScore provides an input image and text prompt, and evaluates on optical-flow-based heuristics for dynamics. We focus on “Motion Accuracy” (MA) and “Camera Control” (Cam) scores. The original motion evaluation assumes a static camera, thus we make slight modifications to accommodate the moving camera, detailed in § F of the Appendix. We evaluate on 15 scenes selected randomly from the benchmark, each with 6 different camera trajectories, on a total of 90 videos for WorldScore. Standard errors are reported in the Appendix.
blocks.zh: WorldScore提供了输入图像和文本提示,并评价基于光学流的动力学. 我们的重点是“运动精确度”(MA)和“控制卡梅拉”(Cam)。 最初的运动评价假设是静态相机,因此我们略作修改,以适应移动相机,详见附录第F节。 我们从基准中随机挑选出15个场景,每个场景有6个不同的相机轨迹,对WorldScore总共90个视频进行评估. 标准错误在附录中报告。

blocks.en: State-of-the-art camera-controlled models struggle with dynamics. While methods like Hydra [ 6 ] and LiveWorld [ 9 ] improve out-of-frame dynamics by modifying their memory, they still struggle with in-frame dynamics. We show that DynaTokens, via test-time training, effectively enables dynamics.

For WorldPlay, we evaluate their camera-post-trained checkpoint. We also compare with Genie3 [ 10 ] qualitatively on a small set of samples due to the UI-only access and queue time. Refer to § F for more details.

blocks.en: We additionally perform human evaluation, shown on the right. We perform pairwise ranking between DynaTokens and each baseline. For every baseline, we show DynaTokens’ win rate against it across 100 rankings done by 5 independent annotators. DynaTokens shows clear advantage of 71%-95.5% win rate for dynamics. blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with other test-time methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与其他试验时间方法的比较

blocks.en: We have shown DynaTokens to effectively “teach” camera-controlled models dynamics while maintaining camera via test-time training in the previous section. Now, we further show that alternative test-time training methods are not as effective. We compare DynaTokens with LoRA, modified LoRA to preserve the PRoPE branch (LoRA-no PRoPE), fine-tuning last model blocks, and TTT layer for video models introduced by [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们向DynaTokens展示了有效的“教学”相机控制模型动态,同时在上一节通过测试时间培训保持相机。 现在,我们进一步表明,替代测试时间培训方法没有那么有效。 我们比较了DynaTokens和LORA,修改了LORA以保留PROPE分支(LORA-no PROPE),微调了最后一个模型块,TTT层用于[7]引入的视频模型.

blocks.en: Table 1 (b) shows results on VBench2 (DSR, MOU) and WorldScore. For each method, we use WorldPlay as the base model, and train on the same trajectories. We evaluate on 3 seen and 3 unseen camera trajectories for each scene to calculate the average score for dynamics and camera control. We test-time train each method on 12 distinct scenes and evaluate a total of 72 videos.
blocks.zh: 表1(b)显示V Bench2(DSR、谅解备忘录)和WorldScore的结果。 对于每一种方法,我们使用WorldPlay作为基模,并在相同的轨迹上进行训练. 我们用3个可见和3个看不见的相机轨迹来评估每个场景,以计算动态和相机控制的平均得分. 我们在12个不同的场景上进行测试时间训练,共评价72个视频。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , DynaTokens shows clear advantage in dynamics learning across both benchmarks and all metrics, corroborating our hypothesis that disentangled design for localized dynamic learning enables effective learning while maintaining camera control. In the qualitative examples shown in Fig. 3 (bottom), all other methods fail to fully learn dynamics, such as making the person “get up and stretch”, or making the kangaroo “jump to the right of the box”. More qualitative examples can be found in § A in the Appendix and the project webpage.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,DynaTokens在跨越基准和所有衡量尺度的动态学习中显示出明显的优势,证实了我们的假设,即局部动态学习的分散设计在保持相机控制的同时,能够有效学习. 在图3(从下到下)所示的定性例子中,所有其他方法都未能充分学习动态,例如使人“起来伸展”,或使袋鼠“跳到盒子的右边”。 更多的定性实例可见于附录中的§A和项目网页.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Inference Time
blocks.zh: 图4:推断时间

blocks.en: LoRA, although high in representation capacity, cannot effectively disentangle dynamics from camera, and holistically “steers” the generation output, thus unable to effectively learn dynamics and yields worse camera control. We show additional analysis on LoRA and LoRA-no PRoPE in § 5 . Fine-tuning the last transformer blocks is also not sufficient for learning dynamics. TTT Layer, although preserving camera, shows distorted objects, as shown in the human example of Fig. 3 , and is unable to effectively learn dynamics. More qualitative examples can be found in the appendix, Fig. 11 and Fig. 12 in the Appendix. We provide further analysis on the failure of LoRA and its effect on PRoPE in § 5 .
blocks.zh: LoRA虽然具有很高的能见度,但不能有效地将动态与相机分开,也不能从整体上“检测”生成输出,从而无法有效学习动态并产生更糟糕的相机控制。 我们对LORA和LORA-no PROPE进行了进一步的分析,见第5节。 微调最后的变压器块也不足以学习动力学. TTT 电话 图层虽然保存了相机,但显示扭曲的物体,如图3的人类例子所示,无法有效学习动态. 更多定性实例见附录,图11和图12。 我们进一步分析了LORA的失败及其对PROPE第5节的影响。

blocks.en: In addition to superior performance in both dynamics and camera, DynaTokens is also faster: as shown in Fig. 4 , DynaTokens only adds 7.9 % 7.9\% inference time compared to the base model (WorldPlay), while showing great improvement in dynamics. In comparison, LoRA has a much higher overhead of 57.7 % 57.7\% inference time, despite having fewer parameters (30M = 0.3% of base model 8.6B parameters) than DynaTokens (240M, 2.7% base model parameters). Inference is evaluated on 4 A100 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 除了在动力学和相机上的优异性能外,DynaTokens还更快:如Fig所示. 4, DynaTokens 与基准模型(WorldPlay)相比,只增加了7.9%的7.9QQ推论时间,同时在动力学上表现出了巨大的改进. 相比之下,尽管参数(30M=基准模型8.6B参数的0.3%)比DynaTokens(240M,基准模型参数的2.7%)少,但LORA的间接费却高得多,为57.7%,为57.7%。 对4个A100GPU进行推论评价.

blocks.en: 4.3 Generalization to Unseen Camera Paths
blocks.zh: 4.3 通俗化为不明相机路径

blocks.en: Table 2 : DynaTokens demonstrates strong generalization, evaluated on VBench2.
blocks.zh: 表2:DynaTokens显示在V Bench2上评价的强烈概括。

blocks.en: The space of all possible camera paths is large – given the duration of videos we generate (up to 93 frames), there are more than 10 19 10^{19} total possible camera trajectories. While trained only trains on ≈ 15 \approx 15 camera paths, DynaTokens achieves generalization to diverse camera poses. Table 2 compares DynaTokens’ performance on seen and unseen camera paths on VBench2. Each evaluated unseen and seen path differ by 39.4 degrees geodesic distance on average, and differ completely in the first 28 frames’ action, demonstrating sufficient spread in the exploration trajectories.
blocks.zh: 所有可能的相机路径的空间都很大, 考虑到我们生成的视频持续时间(高达93帧), 虽然只训练了QQ 15\大约15个相机路径的列车,但DynaTokens实现了对多种相机姿势的概括. 表2比较了DynaTokens在V Bench2上的可见和看不见的相机路径上的性能. 每一条未观测和未观测到的路径平均有39.4度的大地测量距离,在前28帧的动作中则完全不同,表明在勘探轨迹上有足够的分布。

blocks.en: 4.4 Enabling diverse dynamics: physics and stylistic change
blocks.zh: 4.4 促进多种动力:物理学和结构变化

blocks.en: We evaluate whether DynaTokens can handle diverse dynamics such as physics and style transformations. While DynaTokens is designed to learn localized dynamics, we stress-test our approach for global style transformations to probe its capability.
blocks.zh: 我们评价DynaTokens是否能够处理物理学和风格转变等多种动态. 虽然DynaTokens是用来学习本地动态的,但我们压力测试我们在全球风格转变中探索其能力的方法。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : DynaTokens enables diverse dynamics, including physics and stylistic changes, whereas current state-of-the-art camera-controlled video models like Lingbot and Genie 3 struggle.
blocks.zh: 图5:DynaTokens可以实现多样的动力学,包括物理和结构变化,而目前最先进的相机控制视频模型如Lingbot和Genie 3的奋斗.

blocks.en:
We show qualitative examples on Physics IQ [ 19 ] and StevoBench [ 18 ] .
As shown on the top of Fig. 5 , the best open-source state-of-the-art model, Lingbot, either fails to evolve physics (ball not rolling) or completely fails to turn the camera. Genie 3, a closed-source state-of-the-art camera-controlled model, also fails to evolve physics correctly. DynaTokens successfully learns to evolve physics in these settings. We evaluate qualitatively since Physics IQ’s evaluation is based on pixel-wise alignment (IoU, MSE) under a static-camera ground truth, which cannot evaluate camera-controlled models. More examples can be found in Fig. 13 in the Appendix.
blocks.zh:
我们展示了物理智商[19]和Stevo Bench[18]的质量实例。
如Fig. 5的顶部所示,最佳开源状态模型Lingbot要么无法进化物理(球不滚动),要么完全无法转动相机. Genie 3,一种闭源最先进的相机控制模型,也未能正确进化物理学. DynaTokens成功学习了在这些环境下进化物理学. 我们进行定性评价,因为Physics IQQs的评价是基于静态-相机地面真理下的像素-视距对齐(IoU,MSE),这不能评价相机控制的模型. 更多例子可见附录中的图13。

blocks.en: As shown on the bottom of Fig. 5 , DynaTokens is capable of stylistic changes such as changing a cityscape into black-and-white line art, or transforming a room into a spaceship, while allowing the viewer to navigate the scene with camera control. Lingbot fails to transform the scene in both cases.
blocks.zh: 如法果下显. 5,DynaTokens具有将城市景观改为黑白线条艺术,或将房间改造为太空飞船等风格变化的能力,同时允许观众以相机控制导航现场. Lingbot在两种情况下都未能改变场景.

blocks.en: 5 Ablations and Analyses
blocks.zh: 5 分析和分析

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that LoRA fails to simultaneously enable dynamics and preserve camera. We provide further analysis.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,LORA未能同时启用动态和保存相机. 我们提供进一步的分析。

blocks.en:
(1) Non-localized effect. While DynaTokens enables localized gating, LoRA is unable to represent such localized functions since its update is “global” to all patches: F ⁡ ( h i ) = ( W + B ​ A ⊤ ) ​ h i F(h_{i})=(W+BA^{\top})\,h_{i} .
The matrix multiplication formulation results in “patch mixing”, and introduces global changes that interfere with camera.
(2) Preserving PRoPE. For models that use PRoPE, the QKV matrix updates from LoRA result in a shift in the PRoPE product, as detailed in § H of the Appendix. To alleviate this, we also experiment with LoRA-no PRoPE, which removes LoRA on the PRoPE path. However, LoRA-no PRoPE drastically worsens dynamics while only slightly improving camera compared to LoRA, as shown in Table 1 (b).
blocks.zh:
(1)非本地化效应. 虽然DynaTokens允许本地化的Gating,但LORA无法代表这种本地化的功能,因为它的更新是对所有补丁的“全局性”的:F →(hi) = (W + B A →) h F(h_{i) = (W + BA^{\top)\,h_{i}.
矩阵乘法配方产生“patch混合”,并引入干扰照相机的全球变化。
(2) 保护个人防护设备。 对于使用PROPE的模型,来自LORA的QKV矩阵更新导致PROPE产品的转变,详见附录第H节. 为了缓解这种情况,我们还实验了Lora-no PROPE,它移除了PROPE路径上的LORA. 然而,如表1(b)所示,LORA-no PROPE使动态急剧恶化,而相机与LORA相比仅略有改进。

blocks.en: We ablate design of DynaTokens, and evaluate alternatives such as adding dynamic tokens directly to the patch tokens (additive), only using one token, changing the token dimensions, and eliminating context noising (using clean historical frames) during training.
blocks.zh: 我们放弃了 DynaTokens 的设计, 并评价替代方案, 例如直接在补丁符号上添加动态符号( 添加), 仅使用一个符号, 改变符号尺寸, 以及在训练时取消上下文点名( 使用干净的历史框架) 。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Ablations on dynamic token design evaluated on VBench2. The current design yields best holistic performance on dynamics and camera. DSR: Dynamic Spatial Relation. MOU: Motion Order Understanding.
blocks.zh: 表 3:在V Bench2上评价的动态令牌设计缺陷. 目前的设计在动力学和相机上获得了最好的整体性能. DSR:动态空间关系. 谅解备忘录:理解动议令。

blocks.en:
Table 3 shows that the current design achieves the best performance overall on VBench2 dynamics tasks, considering both dynamics and camera metrics.
Training with a single dynamic token, while slightly better on camera, compromises dynamics metrics greatly. This is likely because the softmax attention weight, which acts as localized gating, is no longer meaningful. No context noising, although slightly better on the simpler Motion Order Understanding tasks, causes a significant drop in Dynamic Spatial Relations, which require later chunks of the video to produce spatially-correct motions despite the discrepancy between the model’s self prediction at inference time with teacher forcing training.
blocks.zh:
表3显示,考虑到动力学和相机测量,当前设计在V Bench2动力学任务上总体上取得了最佳业绩.
使用单一动态符号进行训练,虽然在照相机上稍好一些,但大大降低了动态计量标准。 这可能是因为软马克思的注意力重量作为局部的吉丁作用,已经不再有意义. 尽管模型的自我预测与教师强迫培训有出入,但没有任何上下文点名,虽然在较简单的“理解运动顺序”任务方面略好一些,但会导致动态空间关系大幅下降,这需要随后的视频块产生空间正确运动。

blocks.en: We probe whether the base model is capable of continuing dynamics after the motion is kick-started by only applying DynaTokens to the first 1/8, 1/4 and 1/2 of the full video. As shown on the right, even only using dynamic tokens for the first 1/8 can yield over 64% successful dynamic trajectories, and using it for the first half yields successful dynamics 88% of the time. This suggests that once the motion is “kick-started”, the base model has the capability of continuing it via autoregressive chunk-by-chunk generation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过将DynaTokens 应用到全视频的首个 1/8, 1/4 和 1/2 上,来探究底模是否能够在运动启动后继续动态. 如右图所示,即使是在前1/8中使用动态符号,也能产生超过64%的成功动态轨迹,在前半段使用该轨迹,也会产生88%的成功动态. 这表明,一旦运动“踢动启动”,该基模型就有能力通过自递式逐个整流发电来继续运动。

blocks.en: We also evaluate the application DynaTokens on longer videos, showcasing that the learned dynamics is not limited to the training duration, shown in Fig. 19 in the Appendix.
blocks.zh: 我们还在更长的视频上评价应用程序DynaTokens,显示学到的动态不限于培训时间,附录图19所示。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions and Discussions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和讨论

blocks.en: Dynamic scenes are a key challenge in camera-controlled world models. We present DynaTokens, a lightweight add-on module that can be test-time-trained to enable camera-controlled video models to learn localized dynamics for a given scene. This design is able to “selectively” teach dynamics while enabling good camera control, whereas other designs such as LoRA fail. We provide analysis on why the design of dynamic tokens can effectively disentangle local dynamics with global camera control, and show analyses with attention weights to demonstrate the localized gating effect of our design. DynaTokens, via test-time training, greatly surpasses current state-of-the-art camera-controlled video models on VBench2 dynamic categories and WorldScore, and can extend to physical dynamics and style transfer. Our analysis on the dynamic token design sheds light on the representation of dynamics and camera control for video models. DynaTokens also opens up data generation for dynamic-rich, camera-controlled videos in diverse settings, paving the way for generating dynamic, navigable worlds in the future. For more info, visit our project page https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/ .
blocks.zh: 动态场景是相机控制世界模型中的一个关键挑战. 我们介绍DynaTokens,一个轻量级加载模块,可以进行测试时间训练,使相机控制的视频模型能够学习特定场景的局部动态. 这种设计能够“有选择地”传授动力学,同时能够进行良好的相机控制,而LORA等其他设计则失败。 我们分析了为什么动态符号的设计能够有效地将本地动态与全球相机控制分开,并用注意的权重显示分析,以展示我们的设计的局部成形效果. DynaTokens通过测试时间训练,大大超越了VBench2动态类别和WorldScore上目前最先进的相机控制视频模型,可以扩展到物理动态和风格转移. 我们对动态符号设计的分析揭示了动态的体现和视频模型的相机控制. DynaTokens还打开了数据生成,用于不同环境下的动态丰富,相机控制的视频,为未来生成动态,可导航的世界铺平了道路. 欲了解更多信息,请访问我们的项目网页https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Table 6 : Comparison of DynaTokens and VPT/APT. Naive prefix tuning methods cannot disentangle dynamics from camera control, and struggles to learn dynamics effectively.
blocks.zh: 表6:DynaTokens和VPT/APT的比较。 直觉前缀调制方法不能从相机控制中分解动力学,也难以有效学习动力学.

blocks.en: We perform additional comparison with prefix-tuning methods, Visual Prompt Tuning (VPT) [ 13 ] (and its video version APT [ 3 ] ) on a subset of evaluation scenes. The implementation of VPT/APT in the camera-controlled video generation setting is the same. When trained on the same data, VPT/APT struggles to learn dynamics effectively, stays close to the static settings for many (especially unseen) trajectories, and sometimes generates artifacts such as duplicating objects. Quantitatively, DynaTokens shows a significant advantage in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 我们与前缀调制方法进行额外的比较,视觉快速调制(VPT)[13](及其视频版本APT[3])在一组评价场景上. 在相机控制的视频生成设定中VPT/APT的应用相同. 当接受同一数据的培训时,VPT/APT努力有效地学习动力学,保持与许多(尤其是不可见的)轨迹的静态设置相近,有时会产生复制物体等文物. 在数量上,DynaTokens在表6中显示出显著优势。

blocks.en: The comparison with VPT and APT illustrates an important design aspect of DynaTokens. While VPT and APT were originally designed for recognition (VPT for images, and APT a more efficient version for videos), applying them to camera-controlled video generation means inserting trainable “data tokens” alongside the original data tokens. While DynaTokens also inserts new tokens, the mechanism of token interaction with the base model is very different. Unlike VPT/APT, DynaTokens does not participate in the global self attention alongside the data tokens, where camera control takes place. As shown in Fig. 1 (a) in the main paper, the camera conditioning happens via PRoPE in the self-attention. VPT/APT-style methods will interfere with camera conditioning (the added tokens are entangled in the camera and data path), thus failing to disentangle object movement from camera movement. This entanglement is exactly the source of issues with camera-controlled video models and the motivation behind DynaTokens.
blocks.zh: 与VPT和APT的比较说明了DynaTokens的一个重要设计方面. 虽然VPT和APT最初是为了识别而设计的(VPT用于图像,APT用于视频更有效率的版本),但将其应用于相机控制的视频生成意味着在原始数据符号的同时插入可训练的“数据符号”。 虽然DynaTokens也插入了新的符符,但符符符与基模型的互动机制却大不相同. 与VPT/APT不同,DynaTokens不参与全球自注意与数据符,相机控制在此进行. 如主要纸张图1(a)所示,相机的调制是在自觉时通过PROPE进行的. VPT/APT风格的方法会干扰相机的调制(添加的符号被缠在相机和数据路径中),从而未能将物体运动从相机运动中分离出来. 这种缠绕正是用相机控制的视频模型和DynaTokens背后的动机引发问题的根源.

blocks.en: We quantify DynaTokens’ attention localization by measuring the overlap between attention maps with SAM [ 21 ] masks via IoU and IoU-d1 (relaxing the IoU by counting all distance ≤ \leq 1 neighbors as correct). Additionally, DynaTokens work in latent patches which are coarse spatially and temporally (a latent patch is 16x16 pixels across 4 physical frames), and thus we expect coarse overlap rather than accurate, high-IoU boundary alignment. blocks.en: Appendix F Benchmark Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录F 基准评价详情

blocks.en: For VBench2 evaluation, we use the “Dynamic Spatial Relations” and “Motion Order Understanding” categories. We use VBench’s original VLM evaluation framework with minor modifications to accommodate camera movement, since the original framework is designed for static camera. For example, VBench2 determines object spatial relation by the first and last frame. Since camera-controlled models might occasionally turn the camera away from the main object ( e.g., camera turns left while object moves right and out of frame), we add an “object presence” detection and only apply this check when the main object is present in the last frame. We also remove the questions solely based on the first frame, since all methods we test take the same first frame as input. We use Gemini 2.5 Flash instead of Llava for better spatial relation understanding. To avoid Gemini bias, we additionally use GPT-5 for verification, which yields very similar results: the mean difference is 0.025, which is less than 10% of the observed advantage of DynaTokens over the best baseline (Lingbot) on dynamic spatial relations. For methods that generate highly distorted or unrecognizable subjects, we add “recognizable and not distorted” to the evaluation prompt. We use a state-of-the-art camera estimation method, ViPE [ 12 ] to estimate camera, and calculate camera score based on a geometric mean of rotation and translation errors, where rotation error is denoted by geodesic distance, similar to WorldScore [ 8 ] . Since the translation is dependent on the unit for each model, we apply scaling to correct for the unit conversion.
blocks.zh: 对于V Bench2评价,我们使用“动态空间关系”和“运动秩序理解”两个类别。 我们使用V Bench最初的VLM评价框架,稍作修改以适应相机运动,因为最初的框架是为静态相机设计的. 例如,V Bench2通过第一个和最后一个框架确定对象空间关系. 由于相机控制的模型有时可能会使相机脱离主对象(例如,相机在对象左右移动时左转),所以我们添加一个"对象存在"的检测,并且只有在主体存在于最后帧时才应用这个检查. 我们还完全根据第一个框架去除问题,因为我们测试的所有方法都采用与输入相同的第一个框架. 我们用双子座2.5闪电 而不是Llava来更好地理解空间关系 为了避免双子座偏差,我们额外使用GPT-5进行核查,结果非常相似:平均差值为0.025,这还不到DynaTokens在动态空间关系上相对于最佳基线(Lingbot)的观测优势的10%. 对于产生高度扭曲或无法识别主题的方法,我们在评价的提示中加上“可识别和不扭曲”。 我们使用最先进的相机估计方法,VIPE [12]来估计相机,并根据旋转和翻译错误的几何平均值计算相机得分,其中旋转错误以大地测量距离表示,类似于WorldScore [8]. 由于每个模型的翻译取决于单位,所以我们应用缩放来纠正单位的转换.

blocks.en: The WorldScore benchmark’s dynamic evaluation is largely based on optical flow, and assumes a static camera (thus low background flow). To adapt it to the moving camera setting, we adapt the Motion Accuracy and Camera Control metrics. Two other metrics, Motion Magnitude and Motion Smoothness, are both dominated by camera-induced flow rather than scene dynamics and are thus not suitable for this task. Motion Accuracy uses SEA-RAFT [ 28 ] dense flow and SAM2 [ 20 ] object masks to score whether the prompted subject moves more than its surroundings; we (i) set the object-region flow to zero when SAM2 fails to localize the subject, so lost or distorted subjects are penalized rather than collapsing into a whole-frame statistic, and (ii) replace the background maximum with the background median , since under camera motion the background flow distribution is heavy-tailed and its maximum is unstable. Camera Control recovers the trajectory via DROID-SLAM [ 27 ] and scores the clipped geometric mean of rotation geodesic error and scale-aligned translation ℓ 2 \ell_{2} error, with C ∗ = arg ⁡ min C ⁡ ‖ t gt − C ​ t pred ‖ 2 C^{*}=\arg\min_{C}\|t_{\text{gt}}-C\,t_{\text{pred}}\|_{2} ; we constrain C ∈ [ c min , c max ] C\in[c_{\min},c_{\max}] to avoid the loophole where under-translating prediction is rescaled to match the ground-truth magnitude.

(iii) Interpolation and stitching. Consecutive keyframes ( S ^ i − 1 , S ^ i ) (\hat{S}_{i-1},\hat{S}_{i}) are bridged by a dual-endpoint image-to-video interpolator, Kling o3 [ 24 ] , guided by a transition caption that the VLM writes from the two endpoints and the camera-action label. blocks.en: It is important to note that, although our curated videos contain both scene and camera motion, stitching can introduce artifacts in background appearance and motion continuity. For example, the scene layout or object appearance may change across frames, and temporal discontinuities may arise. Qualitative examples can be found in Fig. 6 . However, since the base model remains frozen and dynamic tokens contribute only through localized, additive cross-attention, this imperfect supervision can teach scene dynamics without corrupting the pretrained prior. Model inference calls take 16 minutes on 8 A100 GPUs (with shared prefix skipping), and API call for Gemini and Kling cost $1.52 for all training trajectories. Our DynaTokens design can train on few trajectories, enabling camera-controlled models to produce correct dynamics for new, unseen camera trajectories.
blocks.zh: 需要注意的是,尽管我们所制作的录像既包含场景动作,也包含相机动作,但缝合可以在背景外观和动作连续性方面引入文物. 例如,场景布局或物体外观可能会跨帧变化,时空不连续也会出现. 图6列出了定性实例。 然而,由于基础模型仍然冻结,动态符号只能通过本地化,添加剂交叉注意来贡献,这种不完善的监管可以教场景动态,而不会腐蚀事先训练过的场景. 模型推导调用8个A100GPU需要16分钟(使用共享前缀跳过),API调用双子座和克林座则花费1.52美元,用于所有训练轨迹. 我们的DynaTokens设计可以在少数轨迹上进行训练,使相机控制的模型能够为新的,看不见的相机轨迹产生正确的动力学.

blocks.en: We train K = 16 K=16 dynamic tokens of dimension m = 64 m=64 in our experiments, for videos ranging from 61 to 93 frames. We use the Muon [ 14 ] optimizer with learning rate 3e-3 with weight decay and L2 regularization. The training memory is around 22GB on 4 GPUs, for which we use 40GB or 80GB A100s. For context noising, we add high noise (step [500, 985)) to the context chunks. Training takes 80 minutes for 15 trajectories (total 900 frames). To put this in context, just doing inference using Lyra2, a baseline video model, on our 6 evaluation trajectories, takes 66 A100 minutes. This suggests the test-time adaptation, which unlocks inference on diverse unseen trajectories, is not a huge overhead compared to the per-trajectory inference cost.
blocks.zh: 我们在实验中训练K = 16 K = 16 维度m = 64 m = 64的动态符号,用于61到93帧的视频. 我们使用Muon [14] 优化器,学习率3e-3,重量衰减和L2正规化. 训练记忆器在4个GPU上约为22GB,我们为此使用了40GB或80GB A100s. 对于上下文的点名,我们在上下文块中加入高噪音(步骤[500,985]). 训练15个轨距(共计900帧)需要80分钟. 以此为背景, 使用Lyra2进行推论, 一个基线视频模型, 在我们的6个评估轨迹上, 需要66 A100分钟。 这说明试验时间的适应性,它解析了对各种看不见的轨迹的推论,与每轨推论的成本相比,并不是一个巨大的间接费用.

blocks.en: DynaTokens is a lightweight module added to pretrained video models. Dynamic tokens enable dynamics by effectively disentangling it from camera control. However, if the base model is poor at certain dynamics, learning with dynamic tokens should not expect to fully fix these issues, such as complex physics.
blocks.zh: DynaTokens是预训视频模型中添加的轻量级模块. 动态符号通过有效地将其从相机控制中脱落而使动态成为可能. 然而,如果基准模型在某些动力学上表现不佳,用动态符号学习不应该指望完全解决这些问题,例如复杂的物理学.

We also provide more analysis on why LoRA-No PRoPE fails.
While it does not significantly reduce the number of free parameters compared to normal LoRA, this might be causing great discrepancy between the PRoPE vs. non-PRoPE stream (which was designed to be symmetric in the original architecture), thus hindering learning. This shows that LoRA, with its global entanglement across spatial patches, struggles to only learn dynamics without affecting camera control. Dynamic tokens, on the other hand, minimizes the effect on PRoPE by being local - unaffected patches’ keys and values stay mostly stable.

blocks.en: Appendix I Societal Impact
blocks.zh: 附录一 社会影响

blocks.en: We improve generative video models. We acknowledge that generative models can be used in ways that raise ethical concerns, including the creation of misleading synthetic media, amplification of societal biases present in training data, and potential misuse for surveillance or harmful automation. Our work is intended solely for scientific research purposes and focuses on advancing the understanding and capability of generative modeling systems. We do not release systems or artifacts designed for deceptive or malicious use, and we encourage responsible deployment practices, including transparency about generated content, careful dataset curation, and evaluation for fairness and safety.
blocks.zh: 我们改进了基因视频模型。 我们承认,基因模型的使用方式会引起道德关切,包括制造误导性合成媒介,扩大培训数据中存在的社会偏见,以及可能滥用监视或有害自动化。 我们的工作完全是为了科学研究的目的,侧重于增进基因模型系统的理解和能力。 我们不释放为欺骗或恶意使用而设计的系统或文物,我们鼓励负责任的部署做法,包括所生成内容的透明度、仔细的数据集整理、公平与安全的评价。
